name: Pennylane Invoice Creator
description: Receive a protected invoice request, find or create its Pennylane customer, and return a finalized invoice without sending email.
requirements: Pennylane company API token with customers:all and customer_invoices:all scopes
Configured sequential invoice numbering in Pennylane
HTTP Basic authorization secret for the webhook
Approved customer, line-item, currency and VAT data

source.path: Other_Integrations_and_Use_Cases/Create and send Pennylane invoices from webhook data.json

recommendationReasons: Create a finalized Pennylane invoice after finding or creating its customer.
